Program
Overview

As a member of the Commonwealth of Nations, nestled in the heart of the Pacific Ocean, Nauru is the world’s smallest island country and maintains close ties with Australia and New Zealand. These relationships include special arrangements that allow Nauruan citizens to work in Australia and enable certain refugees to resettle in New Zealand. Launched in 2024, the Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Programme aims to support Nauru’s sustainable future while advancing global citizenship objectives, contributing to the long-term resilience of both Nauru and the broader Pacific region.

Eligibility Criteria

  1. Main Applicant

    • At least 18 years of age
    • No criminal record
    • Source of funds fulfills investment requirements

  2. Eligibility of Dependents

    • Spouse or de facto partner
    • Unmarried children not older than 30 years old
    • Parents and grandparents above 55 years of age
    • Unmarried siblings and siblings-in-law

Program Benefits

  • Family Friendly: siblings and de facto partners can be included
  • Special Arrangements of the Pacific Region: Special residency, work, and study opportunities with Australia and New Zealand
  • No mandatory travel or residency requirements
  • Gain access to a stable, sustainable economic environment

About the Nauru Program

The Republic of Naoero, formally known as Nauru, launched its Citizenship by Investment program on January 1, 2025. This is part of the Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Act. Qualifying investors receive full legal citizenship with the freedom to travel and do business.

The Nauru citizenship by investment program offers a quick pathway to citizenship. This is a remote process with no in-country visit requirements. The program is known for its fast application process approval.

There is only one investment route: a direct contribution to national development. Investment starts from US$90,000 under the current limited-time Iruwa Initiative. 

North Arista is an authorised agent for the Nauru CBI Program. We guide investors to get their application approved.

Why Nauru Citizenship Matters?

A Nauruan passport provides visa-free access to a number of destinations, including the UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong, and South Korea. Your entry is subject to each country’s entry rules and regulations. For investors from markets where travel documentation is a recurring obstacle, this access removes friction from international business.

Nauru citizenship is best viewed as insurance citizenship for internationally mobile entrepreneurs and high-net-worth individuals.

The Nauru citizenship by investment program allows foreigners to get the passport in 3-4 months. The current estimated total cost for a single applicant, including government fees, is US$102,700. The current estimated total cost for a family application, including government fees, is US$115,700. Under the standard pricing, the base contribution is US$115,000.

Investment contributions flow into the Nauru Treasury Fund. The Fund finances economic growth, infrastructure projects, renewable energy, and climate resilience projects in the country. Your investment directly supports a small island nation facing real environmental pressures. This makes it one of the few CBI programs with a verifiable national purpose. 

Investment Route and Costs

The Nauru CBI Program currently has one investment route.

1) Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Contribution — Starting From US$90,000

This is a direct, non-refundable contribution to the national Treasury Fund. The Iruwa Initiative reduces the overall cost of Nauru’s Citizenship by Investment Program by up to 30% for single applicants and families until December 31, 2026. The standard contribution after this date returns to US$115,000 for a single applicant.

A Note on Total Cost

The starting contribution is not your total application cost. Government fees, due diligence fees, and processing charges also apply. North Arista provides a full cost breakdown during your eligibility assessment.

Nauru Citizenship by Investment Processing Time

Nauru’s program takes approximately 4 months. The actual timeline depends on the completeness of your documentation and the due diligence review stage. The process is fully remote with no minimum stay or visit requirements.

Incomplete or inconsistent documentation is the most common reason for delays. Early preparation saves you a lot of time. North Arista will guide you through document requirements and each stage of the application.

Nauru Citizenship Requirements

Applicants must meet the program’s eligibility and due diligence requirements. Applicants must be of good character and have no criminal record. Qualifying investors must get funds from a legal source and make the required contribution through the approved government channel.

Dual citizenship is allowed, and you can keep your existing passport. There is no residency requirement. The entire process is remote. Eligible dependents may include a spouse, children, parents, and siblings, subject to program rules. 

Check Your Eligibility

The minimum US$90,000 contribution under the Iruwa Initiative does not represent the total cost of the application. Government fees, due diligence, and other applicable processing fees are included in the total cost.

A Closer Look: Strategizing Your Nauru Plan

When clients come to us looking for a modern and highly efficient “Plan B”, they usually expect us to recommend the Caribbean programs. Lately, we have been pointing them toward the Pacific. Historically known as “Pleasant Island”, Nauru is the world’s smallest island nation, offering a tropical, peaceful living environment. Despite its size, it holds a unique position as a Commonwealth member that uses the Australian Dollar (AUD) as its official currency, bringing reliable financial stability to its citizens.

While the island was once famous for its vast phosphate reserves that drove its early economy, the country has now shifted its focus toward a sustainable future. In 2024, the government launched the Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Program. Some might see its recency as a disadvantage, but we actually view it as a major strength. By entering the market later, the government was able to study decades of global mobility trends. They built a modern, transparent, and well-structured framework from day one, mainly focusing on climate resilience and sustainable infrastructure. For investors exploring a nauru citizenship by investment program, it provides a highly regulated, direct path to expand their global freedom and safeguard their hard-earned wealth. Now let’s look at why this Pacific nation is quickly becoming a top choice for smart entrepreneurs.

Targeted Mobility for Asia and the Middle East

When evaluating global mobility, it is crucial to look at where your business actually takes you. Holding a nauru passport grants you visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry to over 100 destinations worldwide. While this provides excellent overall travel freedom, the true nauru citizenship benefits become obvious if your commercial focus is in the East.

You gain straightforward access to major business hubs across Asia and the Middle East, including Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Malaysia, and the UAE. We recently assisted a tech founder who needed to visit suppliers in Hong Kong, meet investors in Singapore, and attend a conference in Dubai – all within the same month. With this passport, he simply booked the flights and headed straight to his meetings in different regions, without wasting weeks on visa applications.

The Pacific Advantage and Unmatched Family Inclusion

Beyond standard travel, the country holds close ties with Australia and New Zealand. This relationship includes special arrangements that can open up unique residency, work, and study opportunities in both of these major Pacific nations. For many parents, knowing their children have a potential pathway to study or work in Sydney or Auckland is a life-changing advantage.

Speaking of families, the dependent policy here is one of the most generous and flexible we have seen in the industry. Basically, you can include your spouse, dependent children, parents, and grandparents. But it goes much further. The program allows you to include siblings, siblings-in-law, and even de facto partners on the same application.

Recently, an investor came to us seeking to secure a backup plan for his extended family. Apart from his parents and grandparents, he also wanted to include his long-term de facto partner, his sister, and his partner’s brother. Nauru stood out as one of the very few global options that made this possible without the headache of submitting multiple separate applications.

A Highly Capital-Efficient Structure

How do you structure the investment? Securing nauru citizenship by investment is remarkably straightforward. There are no physical properties to manage. You simply make a direct contribution to the National Treasury Fund.

The standard minimum investment starts at $90,000 for a single applicant. This money actively supports the country’s climate resilience and infrastructure projects. It feels highly rewarding to know your capital is helping to build a sustainable future for a Pacific island nation.

Investors appreciate this route mainly because it is a clean, one-time payment with zero ongoing upkeep costs. Even better, the government is currently running a limited-time offer to celebrate the program’s first anniversary. Until December 31, 2026, a single applicant can qualify with a contribution of just $90,000. This makes it one of the most cost-effective citizenship by investment routes offered globally today. Since this promotional price is only available until this December, we highly recommend starting your initial assessment early so you can secure this advantage before it ends.

High-Efficiency Vetting and Streamlined Processing

For many executives, having a clear and predictable processing timeline is just as important as the passport itself. Getting your nauru citizenship approval typically takes just 3 to 4 months from start to finish.

The government conducts thorough background checks to ensure only individuals with an excellent personal record and clear source of funds are approved. The official unit operates with remarkable efficiency. Here is how the timeline works in practice:

During the first few weeks, our advisory team handles the heavy document preparation. Instead of just giving you a list of required files, our consultants actively help you map out your financial history so it is easy for the authorities to review and verify.

Once we officially submit your application, the government begins its rigorous due diligence process. This is the standard waiting period. During this review window, applicants aged 16 and older will also complete a mandatory virtual interview. There is absolutely no need to stress. We provide clear, practical guidance on what to expect so you feel completely confident and prepared for this conversation.

After clearing all checks, the government issues an official approval letter. You only transfer your actual investment funds after receiving this official green light. Shortly after the payment clears, your certificates and passports are securely delivered to your home. With your new passports in hand, the borders that once restricted you simply fade away, officially opening the doors to a truly global life.
